newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM's top aide said stepping down -- Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM's top aide said stepping down -- Kyodo.

text.p: Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama, a top aide to Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, told the prime minister on Friday he intends to resign his post, Kyodo news agency quoted political sources as saying.
Hashimoto urged the 71-year-old Kajiyama to stay on, the report said. A full cabinet reshuffle is expected as early as next month, political analysts say.

As chief cabinet secretary, Kajiyama serves as the Japanese cabinet and government's main spokesman. He also plays a key coordinating role among the cabinet, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party and the powerful central bureaucracy.
